visual_review: Pale pearl-ivory blade, collar, shaft and counterweight with ivory binding; three faint ochre blade daubs remain in original positions. Three deep notches, weld bead, two collar rivets, three grip nails and single butt bolt preserved. Thin contained ivory-gold back line and collar ornament retained. Original shaft/butt ochre wear daubs are very faint to absent and are disclosed for review; no exact silhouette approval.
